content: Hi, #36320 (Schreier graph basics (a generalization of Cayley graph), ~170 lines) has been open for about a week with no reviewer assigned yet. Would appreciate any comments and suggestions!

Update: Yaël reviewed the code style and suggested looking for someone more familiar with Schreier graphs specifically. Is anyone working with Schreier graph or Cayley graph (or group actions on graphs in general) able to review the mathematical content? Thanks a lot!
I added some comments, but they're mostly about the formalization. For the moment, the definitions look fine to me.
Hi @Antoine Chambert-Loir , thanks again for the review! I have addressed all the comments. Could you add the ready-to-merge label when you get a chance?
Thanks Snir! @Antoine Chambert-Loir , could you please add the maintainer-merge label instead?
Please check out the links I sent
Thanks Snir, I checked the links you sent, but I'm not sure what the right next step is. Should I be looking for an official reviewer to add the label?

You could try looking through who reviewed other Quiver PRs
Also worth noting- approval is valuable even if it isn't from an official reviewer
Hi @Oliver Nash , do you by chance have time to take a look at #36320? I saw you reviewed some similar PRs related to Quivers. Antoine has reviewed and approved this one.
